blocks.text: Compound lipids fatty acids ke aise alcohols ke saath esters hain jin mein koi additional (izafi) group bhi ho, jaise phosphate, nitrogen wala base, carbohydrate ya protein. Phospholipid fat molecule jaisa hota hai, lekin is mein glycerol se teen ki bajaye sirf do fatty acids jure hote hain. Glycerol ka teesra hydroxyl group phosphate group se jura hota hai, jo molecule ko polar (charge ke lihaz se do siron wala) bana deta hai. Hydrocarbon tails (dumein) hydrophobic hain, jab ke phosphate group aur us se jure hisse aik hydrophilic (paani pasand) head (sar) banate hain jis ki paani se affinity (kashish) hai (Figure 27.11).

Jab phospholipids paani mein dale jayen to yeh double-layered sheet (dohri teh wali chadar) banate hain jise 'bilayer' kehte hain. Polar ends (sire) bahar (paani ki taraf) rehte hain aur non-polar ends andar aapas mein apni alag teh mein ikatthe ho jate hain. Tamam cell membranes ki structure yahi hai. Kuch liposomes artificial (insan ke banaye hue) phospholipids hain jo paani mein ghulne wali (hydrophilic) dawaiyan pohanchane ke liye use hote hain.

blocks.alt: Baen: phospholipid ka gol hydrophilic (paani pasand) head aur do hydrophobic (paani se door) tails. Daen: block diagram jis mein glycerol aik fatty acid, doosre fatty acid, aur phosphate (PO4) se jura hai jo aik alcohol se juri hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 27.11: Phospholipids ki basic structure (bunyadi banawat) (kitab ki Figure 27.11 ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dono hisse aik hi molecule hain: block diagram ke do fatty acids hi do hydrophobic tails hain, aur glycerol se juri PO₄ aur alcohol hydrophilic head hain. Paani mein yeh molecules tails andar aur heads bahar kar ke bilayer banate hain.
Lipoproteins lipids aur proteins ke complexes hain jo hydrophobic lipids (jaise cholesterol aur triglycerides) ko khoon (bloodstream) mein aik jagah se doosri jagah le jate hain.
Glycolipids woh lipids hain jin se carbohydrate (sugar) groups jure hon; yeh zyada tar nervous tissue (asaab ke tissue) mein milte hain.

blocks.title: Did You Know? (kya aap jante hain?)
blocks.text: Liposomes paani pasand (hydrophilic) cancer ki dawaiyan pohanchane ke liye behtareen hain. In ki banawat aisi hai ke lipid bilayer andar ke paani wale hisse (watery core) ko gher leti hai; is core mein paani mein ghulne wali dawa band ho jati hai, tootne se bachi rehti hai aur cell ke andar aasani se dakhil hoti hai. Liposomes dawa ki solubility barhate hain aur use seedha tumor (rasoli) ke cells tak pohanchate hain.

blocks.alt: Liposome: aik gola jis ki deewar lipid bilayer hai, laal heads bahar ke paani aur andar ke aqueous core ki taraf aur tails darmiyan mein. Hare hydrophilic dawa ke particles aqueous core (andar ka paani wala hissa) mein; neele lipophilic dawa ke particles bilayer ke andar. Labels: aqueous core, lipidic bilayer, hydrophilic drug, lipophilic drug.
blocks.caption: Liposome (kitab ke Did You Know box ki liposome tasveer ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.prompt: Phospholipids paani mein bilayer kyun banate hain?
blocks.explanation: Har molecule ka head hydrophilic (polar) aur tails hydrophobic (non-polar) hain; paani mein heads dono taraf paani ki taraf rehte hain aur tails dohri teh ke andar paani se chhupi rehti hain.

items: Compound lipids mein additional group hota hai (phosphate, base, carbohydrate, protein).
Phospholipid: polar head, do non-polar tails; paani mein bilayer, yahi cell membrane hai.
Lipoproteins khoon mein lipids le jate hain; glycolipids nervous tissue mein.
